S. acquired, but left uncut, Friedrich Gottlob Born’s translation of Kant in 1813 (see Hogg ii 311) and
Mary’s journal entry of 1 September 1821 stating that ‘S. reads Kants’ (Mary Jnl i 378). S. seems to see
